title: Make failOn: newWarning work with workspace compilation
summary: The failOn: newWarning setting now detects newly introduced AL compiler warnings when workspace compilation is enabled, by running the check during the compile phase instead of the pipeline phase and handling workspace-format compiler output.
key_points: The newWarning check now runs in the CompileApps action when workspace compilation is on, and RunPipeline skips it in that mode
CheckForWarningsUtils.psm1 moved to Actions/.Modules so both actions can use it
Parser now reads both GitHub annotation format and raw AL compiler output
Four-part version numbers in warning text are normalized so build-number changes do not cause false new warnings
RunPipeline passes an empty buildOutputFile to Run-AlPipeline so the compiler output is kept for the baseline artifact
